# iNEST

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-22

## Definition
iNEST refers to In-Network Neuromorphic computing, an architecture paradigm that embeds neuromorphic computation directly within the network fabric. It is the core architectural framework for integrating SNN-style processing with topology-centric communication and computation.
